title: Desktop apps and tools
summary: RDP desktop access reuses the fixture display or restarts a session orphaned by sesman. The forwarded viewer trusts SSH host-key verification, bypasses the per-port RDP certificate cache, and retains reason-specific client diagnostics. Direct routes verify their certificates. Native Windows --view opens FreeRDP on the host's own RDP listener, splits DOMAIN\user, requests a 1920x1080 remote desktop, fits the operator screen, and reports desktop_session native and resolution. The YokeQa-ReturnToConsole task returns the console after the viewer closes. Native provisioning and reset apply a full-HD console mode, and verify observes it. Linux and WSL start unattended XFCE at 1920x1080 and measure the active display before GUI work. macOS Screen Sharing mirrors the console after Yoke measures it and raises undersized displays to a supported full-HD mode. Linux and WSL desktop provisioning requires --browser-project and --browser-identity naming the operator identity. It registers yoke-identity-browser.desktop, whose Exec runs yoke browser open through bash -lc, as the http, https and text/html handler in mimeapps.list, so desktop links open signed in. Verify refuses linux_desktop_default_browser_not_selected when links bypass that launcher. Provisioning no longer installs snap Chromium or sets x-www-browser. Live host proof is still owed. On native Windows, yoke qa mission desktop lists, focuses, clicks, types into, presses keys in and reads any window through an interactive scheduled task with no console window, so an app menu opened by one action stays open for the next, using Win32 input and UI Automation, with no RDP session; it reports the active resolution, refuses when the console cannot meet the minimum, verifies the foreground before input, reads typed text only from stdin and reports only its length, refuses secret or credential-shaped text, refuses options an action does not use, and names each failure (windows_desktop_locked, windows_window_not_found, windows_window_ambiguous, windows_element_ambiguous with --index N to pick a listed match, windows_foreground_refused). Other operating systems refuse desktop_input_unsupported_os and keep --gui-session osascript or xdotool.
